mentions.name: macOS Assigned Issues Overview App
mentions.description: This macOS app lists the issues assigned to the user, providing a quick overview of their workload. It is built with Swift around simple API integration with the user's issue tracker, built as a personal learning project while transitioning from sysadmin work into IT management.
mentions.problem: The builder wanted a quick overview of issues assigned to them after moving from sysadmin work into IT management.
mentions.source_excerpt: started to build a app (macOS) that just lists the issues assigned to me... Simple API stuff with a bit of Swift around
